newsitem.title: UK: NWE high sulphur barges off on energetic selling.
newsitem.headline: NWE high sulphur barges off on energetic selling.

text.p: NWE high sulphur barges slipped on Thursday as one player sold energetically but other fuel oil markets were lacklustre ahead of Easter, traders said.
After Wednesday's jump to $89 fob ARA, trading began on Thursday at $88. Large volumes were later sold at $86 fob by one trader who continued to offer material in the afternoon at $86.50 fob.
There was little bunker interest, with most needs for the long Easter weekend already met. Barge swaps were off a dollar at $86/$87 for April.
High and low sulphur cargo markets were in the doldrums as traders left their offices early for the Easter break.
"Prices were stable because no-one was moving them one way or another," said one trader. - London newsroom +44 171 542 8060
